decisions.reason: Optical spectrum connectivity builds directly on the firm's owned fibre networks and specialist engineering knowledge, and its promotion to the home page in 2019 shows that management could read its early results as promising, so the firm can keep assimilating and improving it in line with its high-bandwidth strategy.

The voice number ordering portal draws on the firm's existing software platforms and regulatory know-how in voice and supports real-time provisioning, but other voice launches were dropped and its visibility stayed low, so it carries moderate risk while still fitting the firm's knowledge base.
